row: Dr. Altenrath focuses on corrective chiropractic care.  This unique evidenced based care focuses on optimal posture and spinal alignment as the goals of care while at the same time improving pain and function.  Corrective care is helpful for pain, especially chronic pain, that may be coming from discs, joints, and nerves in and around the spine.  Dr. Altenrath provides his patients with specific adjustments, structural rehabilitative exercises, and specific spinal traction based on each individuals specific condition.  His goal is to bring patients to a higher state of health and help them actualize their potential one family at a time.
